**cli:** `flow`, `plan-rollback`, `token-savings`, `squash-branch` and `fast-forward` left the binary and ship as plugins (`pixel install github:Pixel-CLI/pixel-flow`, `pixel-git`, `pixel-telemetry`). Without the plugin each prints that install command and exits 2; `rescue`, `update`, `savings`, `rewrite` and `replay-flow` resolve to the plugin of the current name.
